paths.physical.scenario: Reference experiment: informative coverage, straight-line motion, narrow coverage, or nearly collinear beacons. An explicit path overrides the reference tag path.
paths.physical.samples: Integer 8–100; default 32. Synchronized model: observation epochs. Timing models: display samples; acquisition cycles are controlled by duration and cycle rate.
paths.physical.duration_s: Experiment duration in seconds; default 20. Timing/custom paths allow 0.01–3600 s. Duration and cycle rate must yield 2–100 acquisition cycles.
paths.physical.seed: Measurement/generation random seed; default 7. Nonnegative integer; timing and later models require an unsigned 32-bit integer. Separate from numerical and contamination seeds.
paths.physical.noise_std_m: Injected independent Gaussian range noise SD in metres: scalar or JSON array with one value per beacon. Zero is noiseless; timing and later models allow 0–100. Does not set estimator weights.
paths.physical.path.type: Custom horizontal path: line, circle, arc, rectangle, figure_eight, or waypoint. Overrides the scenario's tag path; truth height is configured separately.
paths.physical.path.center_m: JSON [x,y] translation in metres, each −1000 to 1000; default [5,4]. Applied after local scaling and rotation.
paths.physical.path.size_m: JSON [width,height] in metres, each 0.01–100. Circle/arc require equal entries giving diameter. Waypoint paths use waypoints_m instead.
paths.physical.path.scale: Dimensionless path scale, 0.01–100; default 1. Scales local path coordinates before rotation and translation.
paths.physical.path.rotation_deg: Horizontal path rotation in degrees, −360 to 360; default 0. Applied around the local origin before adding center_m.
paths.physical.path.start_angle_deg: Circle/arc starting angle in degrees, −360 to 360; default 0.
paths.physical.path.arc_angle_deg: Signed arc sweep in degrees, −360 to 360 with magnitude at least 0.01; default 180. Sign selects direction.
paths.physical.path.waypoints_m: JSON array of 2–100 local [x,y] points in metres, coordinates −1000 to 1000. Must have positive total length. Scale, rotation and center are applied afterward.
paths.physical.motion.profile: constant follows uniform path progress; variable includes acceleration, stops and reversal; stationary holds position. This changes synthetic truth, not an estimator velocity input.
paths.physical.motion.speed_scale: Dimensionless path-progress speed multiplier, 0–10; default 1. Zero stops motion; progress is clipped at path endpoints.
paths.physical.acquisition.beacon_order: JSON permutation of every zero-based beacon ID, e.g. [0,1,2,3]. Determines sequential ping offsets within each cycle.
paths.physical.acquisition.cycle_rate_hz: Positive acquisition cycles per second, at most 10000. floor(duration × rate + 1e-10) + 1 must be 2–100. Default for 32 samples over 20 s is 1.55 Hz.
paths.physical.acquisition.spacing_s: Seconds between beacon pings within a cycle, 0–10000; default 0. Nonzero spacing makes pings asynchronous even in the same cycle.
paths.physical.acquisition.jitter_s: Uniform acquisition-time jitter half-width in seconds, 0–10000; default 0. Adds a draw from [−jitter,+jitter] to actual ping time and therefore changes true tag position.
paths.physical.acquisition.timestamp_offset_s: Offset added to supplied estimator timestamps in seconds, −10000 to 10000; default 0. Distinct from actual acquisition time and packet delivery latency.
paths.physical.acquisition.timestamp_jitter_s: Uniform supplied-timestamp jitter half-width in seconds, 0–10000; default 0. Adds a draw from [−jitter,+jitter] after acquisition time and clock offset; models error in the estimator's time input.
paths.physical.acquisition.delivery_latency_s: Nonnegative delivery delay in seconds, up to 10000; default 0. Changes delivery metadata, not measurement geometry or acquisition timestamps.
paths.physical.acquisition.missing_probability: Independent acquisition missing-ping probability, 0–1; default 0. Missing pings never enter the estimator; separate from contamination dropout and fitted rejection.
paths.physical.acquisition.beacon_every_cycles: JSON array of integer cycle strides 1–100, one per beacon. [1,1,1,2] acquires beacon 3 every second cycle.
paths.physical.beacon_layout.count: Integer beacon count 3–8; default 4. Update per-beacon noise, sigma, order, stride, offsets and affected-ID arrays when changing count.
paths.physical.beacon_layout.geometry: equal uses one beacon height; diverse spreads heights; near_collinear and collinear reduce horizontal geometry. Explicit coordinates override generated layout.
paths.physical.beacon_layout.height_m: Nominal generated beacon height in metres, −1000 to 1000; default 3. Not a height supplied to a joint estimator.
paths.physical.beacon_layout.height_spread_m: Total generated beacon height spread in metres, 0–100; default 1. Used only for diverse layout, distributed symmetrically around nominal height.
paths.physical.beacon_layout.baseline_scale: Dimensionless horizontal beacon-map scale, 0.001–100; default 1. Does not scale tag path or explicit coordinates.
paths.physical.beacon_layout.coordinates_m: Optional finite JSON array of count XYZ points in metres. Overrides generated beacon coordinates. Use the optional geometry editor to remove it.
paths.physical.truth_height.type: Synthetic tag Z profile: planar is constant; tilted is an X-dependent plane; excursion is sinusoidal; spatial adds a higher-frequency vertical component. Independent of estimator height assumptions.
paths.physical.truth_height.offset_m: Synthetic tag-height offset in metres, −1000 to 1000; default 0. Applies to all truth-height profiles.
paths.physical.truth_height.amplitude_m: Vertical excursion scale in metres, 0–100; default 0.3. Used for excursion/spatial truth; spatial combines harmonics and can exceed this amplitude.
paths.physical.truth_height.tilt_deg: Synthetic plane tilt in degrees, −80 to 80; default 10. Tilted truth adds tan(tilt) × (x − 5) metres to the height offset.
paths.physical.contamination.nlos.prevalence: NLOS burst-onset probability per eligible beacon per cycle, 0–1; default 0. Overlapping duration windows mean realized contaminated fraction may exceed this value.
paths.physical.contamination.nlos.magnitude_m: Positive injected NLOS range bias in metres, 1e-9–100; default 1. Synthetic labels are evaluation references and never tell the estimator what to reject.
paths.physical.contamination.nlos.burst_durati: Integer NLOS burst length 1–100 cycles; default 1. Each onset marks this many forward cycles, clipped at the experiment end.
paths.physical.contamination.nlos.affected_bea: JSON array of distinct zero-based beacon IDs eligible for NLOS; default all beacons. Empty array disables NLOS on every beacon.
paths.physical.contamination.offsets_m: Fixed range bias in metres: scalar or one JSON entry per beacon, −100 to 100; default all zero. These offsets are injected, not estimated calibration parameters.
paths.physical.contamination.correlated_noise_: Stationary SD of additive per-beacon AR(1) noise in metres, 0–100; default 0. Added to independent white noise.
paths.physical.contamination.correlation: AR(1) correlation between adjacent cycle indices, −0.999 to 0.999; default 0. Independent streams per beacon; not correlation per elapsed second.
paths.physical.contamination.quantization_m: Range quantization step in metres, 0–100; default 0 disables. Rounds to the nearest grid value using ties-to-even; saved assumed sigma is unchanged.
paths.physical.contamination.dropout_probabili: Additional independent dropout probability 0–1 after acquisition selection; default 0. Separate from missing_probability and estimator hard rejection.
paths.physical.contamination.seed: Unsigned 32-bit contamination seed; default measurement seed + 606 modulo 2³² (613 initially). Controls independent onset, correlated-noise and dropout streams.
paths.assumptions.assumed_std_m: Assumed range SD in metres: scalar or one JSON value per beacon. Strictly positive; timing and later models allow 1e-6–1000; default 0.05. Sets residual weights, not injected noise. Immutable when reusing saved observations.
paths.assumptions.mode: joint estimates beacon map and trajectory; known_map fixes the complete explicitly surveyed beacon map. Known-map fitting uses declared knowledge unavailable to joint fitting.
paths.assumptions.timing_model: timestamp_aware evaluates piecewise-linear trajectory at supplied ping timestamps; grouped assigns pings to cycle-start positions. Grouped is an approximation for asynchronous measurements.
paths.assumptions.knot_spacing_s: Trajectory knot interval in seconds, 0–10000; default 0 uses the cycle grid. Controls estimator trajectory resolution; at most 150 knots are supported.
paths.assumptions.prior_sigma_m: Motion smoothness prior SD in metres, 0–10000; default 0 disables. Positive values add prior residuals; smaller means stronger smoothing. Measurement and augmented rank are reported separately.
paths.assumptions.tag_height_model: fixed sets every tag Z to the datum; shared estimates one tag height; soft estimates knot heights with a Gaussian height prior; free estimates unrestricted 3D knot heights.
paths.assumptions.beacon_height_model: shared estimates a common beacon height; independent estimates separate beacon heights. Survey model requires independent. This is an estimator assumption, separate from generated height diversity.
paths.assumptions.fixed_tag_z_m: Tag Z datum or soft-prior target in metres, −1000 to 1000; default 0. Meaning depends on tag-height model and frame; it does not change synthetic truth.
paths.assumptions.height_prior_sigma_m: Soft tag-height prior SD in metres, 1e-6–1000; default 0.2. Smaller values impose a stronger prior; relevant to soft height model.
paths.assumptions.below_beacons: Impose supported below-beacon height bounds. Joint independent beacon heights with free/soft tag heights require unsupported coupled inequalities and reject. This is physical knowledge, not a display option.
paths.assumptions.loss: gaussian is least squares; huber, soft_l1 and cauchy downweight large standardized range residuals; hard_rejection fits a Gaussian pilot then refits retained ranges. Priors remain quadratic.
paths.assumptions.loss_scale_sigma: Robust range-loss scale in units of assumed sigma, 1e-6–1000; default 2. Controls robust transition size; it is not a distance in metres.
paths.assumptions.rejection_threshold_sigma: Hard-rejection cutoff in assumed-sigma units, 1e-6–1000; default 3. Pilot residuals select retained observations. Pilot and final fit statuses remain separate.
paths.assumptions.weight_decision_threshold: Influence-weight flag threshold 0–1; default 0.5. Flags weights below this value for diagnostics; changing it does not define the robust objective or rejection cutoff.
paths.assumptions.uncertainty.enabled: Enable conditional local uncertainty for supported survey fits; default true. Unsupported assumptions produce an explicit withheld reason.
paths.assumptions.uncertainty.range_model: Supported declaration: independent_gaussian_known_sigma. Intervals condition on saved range sigmas, chosen model, constraints and priors; robust curvature is not calibrated covariance.
paths.assumptions.uncertainty.rank_rtol: Relative singular-value rank tolerance 1e-12–1e-4; default 1e-8. Affects local uncertainty rank decisions, not the fitted objective or global uniqueness.
paths.assumptions.uncertainty.bound_tolerance_: Bound proximity tolerance in metres, 1e-12–0.001; default 1e-7. Near-active bounds can withhold local Gaussian intervals.
paths.numerical.solver: trf is bounded trust-region reflective; lm uses strict-interior exponential bound transforms. LM requires at least as many retained residual/prior rows as parameters and cannot attain finite bounds exactly.
paths.numerical.height_parameterization: h uses physical metre coordinates; q = h² uses square metres for one supported positive shared relative height. q does not change ranges to a squared-range objective; free heights and partial survey do not support q.
paths.numerical.initialization: independent uses measurement-based starts; truth_near uses synthetic truth for diagnostic starts only; algebraic requires a supported complete synchronous planar/shared-height experiment and rejects invalid seeds explicitly.
paths.numerical.initialization_error_m: SD of physical-start perturbations in metres, 0–1000; default 0 for independent/algebraic, 0.15 when truth_near is normalized without an explicit value. Perturbations are applied before solver-coordinate conversion.
paths.numerical.algebraic_physical_tolerance: Algebraic initializer physical-consistency tolerance, 1e-12–0.1; default 1e-7. Controls acceptance of recovered physical geometry, not optimizer termination.
paths.numerical.starts: Number of physical initial attempts, integer 1–12 in the app; default 3 (planar 2). Every attempt is retained, including failures and nonconvergence.
paths.numerical.seed: Random seed for physical initial guesses; default 19. Separate from measurement and contamination seeds. Timing and later models require an unsigned 32-bit integer.
paths.numerical.max_nfev: Maximum numerical evaluation budget per start, integer 1–5000 in the app; default 2000 (planar 1000). More budget does not guarantee identifiability or convergence. Hard rejection has separate pilot and final stages.
paths.study.values: JSON array of distinct values for the swept factor, e.g. [0,0.05]. Values must meet native factor validation; model variants and seeds multiply the total workload.
paths.study.seeds: JSON array of distinct measurement seeds, e.g. [7,8]. Cells share observations and compatible physical starts across estimator variants; all outcomes are retained. Native study limits apply.

ids.workspaceEngine: Choose one of six numerical models. Selecting a model loads its default draft; displayed saved results remain unchanged. Unsupported combinations fail validation without switching models.
ids.workspaceObservationSource: Generate new data on Run, or reuse the displayed saved run's exact observations through its Library key. Reuse copies compatible settings and locks physical configuration and saved range sigmas.
ids.workspaceStudyKind: Single fit produces one saved run. Parameter study varies one factor over values/seeds and compared estimators. Survey supports single fits only; studies require newly generated paired observations.
ids.workspaceFactor: Native study factor. Only factors supported by the selected model appear. The user guide explains aliases such as coverage and vertical_separation.
ids.workspaceVariants: Native JSON variants: planar uses [{"label":"budget","max_nfev":200}]; spatial/solver/robust use [{"label":"name","options":{...}}]. null selects defaults. Timing always uses the timestamp-aware/grouped pair.
ids.workspaceGeometryJson: Optional JSON object with path and/or coordinates_m. Path example: {"path":{"type":"circle","size_m":[7,7]}}. Omit path to remove it; null/omitted coordinates_m removes explicit coordinates. Apply validates the draft without fitting.
ids.workspaceSurveyJson: Exact survey JSON: frame world, units m, fixed and priors arrays. Each row has beacon_id, three-boolean mask and mean_m XYZ; priors also require positive-definite selected-axis covariance_m2. No duplicate/overlapping coordinates.
ids.workspaceImportDraft: Paste a complete workspace_version 1 draft containing engine, physical, assumptions, numerical, observation_source and study. Apply draft JSON validates and replaces the editable draft without running a fit.
ids.workspaceAttempt: Select the saved physical start to inspect consistently across scene, metrics, residuals, playback and provenance. Does not launch another optimization.
ids.coordinateMode: Raw shows the estimator frame. Aligned shows a supported rigid evaluation alignment with metre scale preserved. Alignment can remove gauge differences but does not establish global uniqueness.
ids.compareAlignment: Choose raw coordinates or rigid alignment with scale fixed at 1 for A/B comparison. Both sources keep original provenance and share scene scale, camera and elapsed-time reference.
ids.m3PingSlider: Scrub retained ping events. Inspect actual and assumed time, beacon ID, range and tag position. Playback selection does not change saved observations or fitting.
ids.librarySearch: Search saved names, scenarios, IDs and indexed settings. Historical milestone aliases are also searchable. Search changes metadata results only.
ids.libraryType: Filter Library items to runs, benchmarks/sweeps or comparisons; All types includes every supported family.
ids.libraryStatusSelect: Filter by saved outcome. Optimizer convergence, infrastructure failure and unfinished work are retained as recorded; low residual alone does not prove accurate geometry.
ids.libraryModel: Filter by indexed numerical model. Opening historical models validates their original native schema without conversion or fitting.
ids.librarySource: Filter by indexed source/provenance category. Original source JSON remains authoritative.
ids.librarySort: Order metadata by newest, oldest, name or outcome. Sorting does not change stored runs or A/B selections.
ids.libraryMode: Parents + standalone groups studies/comparisons with their recorded children; All runs/items exposes individual entries. Open a parent to inspect its retained child outcomes.
ids.libraryPageSize: Metadata rows per page: 25 (default) or 50 (maximum). A/B selections persist across pages and filters.
ids.importFile: Select workspace draft, native configuration, run, study or comparison JSON. Import validates without fitting; saved sources are retained locally, while configuration imports update only the draft.
ids.libraryImportFile: Import native saved-source JSON or a configuration through the workspace importer. Unsupported or malformed records report validation errors without fitting.

survey.beacon_id: Zero-based beacon ID from 0 through beacon count minus one. A coordinate may occur in only one fixed or prior block.
survey.kind: Fixed eliminates selected coordinates exactly. Uncertain prior adds a Gaussian survey block using covariance in square metres. Neither is an arbitrary coordinate gauge.
survey.mean_m: JSON [x,y,z] survey mean in world-frame metres. Only axes selected by the mask constrain the fit, but all three entries must be finite.
survey.covariance_m2: JSON k × k symmetric positive-definite covariance in m² for the k selected axes, in XYZ order. Example: [[0.01]] means SD 0.1 m. Fixed coordinates have no covariance.
survey.axis: Include this world-coordinate axis in the survey row. At least one of X/Y/Z must be selected; covariance rows and columns follow selected XYZ order.

layers.truth: Show separate synthetic reference trajectory and beacon map. Truth is used for evaluation; independent fitting does not receive it.
layers.estimate: Show the selected attempt's fitted tag trajectory and beacon coordinates.
layers.initial: Show the selected attempt's retained physical initial trajectory and beacon map.
layers.errors: Show displacement vectors between truth and estimated geometry in the selected evaluation frame.
layers.rays: Show sampled measurement connections (at most 45 pings for robust scenes). Robust ray colors reflect estimator influence weights, not injected NLOS labels.
layers.tagPlane: Show the tag reference plane when meaningful for the saved model.
layers.beaconPlane: Show the beacon reference plane when meaningful; independent-height beacons need not occupy a common plane.
